## This project does not accept outside pull requests

Thanks for wanting to improve SuperSLM — this is not a judgment about your
change, and it will still get read on its merits.

**Please close this PR and instead:**

1. Open an [issue](../../issues/new) describing the problem and your proposed change.
2. Link your code as a [gist](https://gist.github.com/) — a unified diff
   (`git diff > change.patch`) is easiest to apply, but whole files are fine.
3. Say how you tested it.

The maintainer applies accepted changes by hand, with attribution in the commit.

**Why:** GitHub Actions grants elevated trust to any author whose pull request
has been merged — their later fork runs start automatically at PR-open time,
before a human reads the diff. Never merging an outside PR keeps every fork run
behind a manual approval gate at every submission. Merging even one good PR
would permanently weaken that gate, so the rule holds without exceptions.

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) for the full policy.
